build_resnet18: build a ResNet-18 model with configurable in_channels, base_planes, and ngroups using BasicBlock
build_resnet50: build a ResNet-50 model with configurable in_channels, base_planes, and ngroups using Bottleneck blocks
build_resneXt50: build a ResNeXt-50 model with grouped convolutions and configurable cardinality
build_se_resnet50: build a SE-ResNet-50 model with squeeze-and-excitation attention in Bottleneck blocks
build_se_resneXt101: build a SE-ResNeXt-101 model with squeeze-and-excitation and grouped convolutions
